metadata.description: FRACTAL multi-tier agent orchestration plugin marketplace. Local checkout distribution.

plugins.name: fractal-core
plugins.description: The FRACTAL orchestration loop itself — epic bootstrap, release maintenance, PULSE heartbeats, HANDOFF generation, quality pass, gap analysis, CLAUDE.md audit, and commit summarization. Install target: every repo adopting FRACTAL.

plugins.name: fractal-planning
plugins.description: Planning and coordination tools for FRACTAL Architects and Strategists — stakeholder briefs, initiative interviews, meeting digests. Install target: repos where a human or agent Architect authors BLUEPRINTs.

plugins.name: fractal-tools
plugins.description: General-purpose developer tools for repos running FRACTAL — commit, review, issue, and exploration helpers. Install target: every repo.

plugins.name: fractal-wiki
plugins.description: Wiki and knowledge-substrate skills for FRACTAL repos — ingest, query with citations, and lint a project's markdown knowledge base. Install target: repos with a wiki/ substrate.

plugins.name: fractal-runner
plugins.description: Installs and operates the FRACTAL scheduled runner, driving unattended workstream execution across local, VM, and manual environments. Install target: repos running the scheduled FRACTAL runner.

plugins.name: fractal-pr-review
plugins.description: PR-review assistance for FRACTAL repos — gathers a PR's diff and CI state, runs bundled reviewers, and triages findings into a severity-ranked table. Install target: repos with active PR flow.
